from_name.description: Display name for the from JAR (-F)

to_name.description: Display name for the to JAR (-T)

output_format.description: Output format: xml, html, xhtml, or text (-o)

xsl_file.description: Path to a custom XSL stylesheet (-x). Empty string disables custom XSL.

stylesheet.description: Href to a stylesheet for HTML output (-s). Empty string uses default.

from_api.description: Relative location of the from API documentation (-fa). Empty string disables link.

to_api.description: Relative location of the to API documentation (-ta). Empty string disables link.
